text:
Sam (Sales): Quick relay into CS/support for Orchid Therapeutics — selling Dedicated (VPC) + SSO. Trial live, main asks below. Pinged @Priya to own CS, @Diego for infra/support. TL;DR: trial metrics look good but customer flagged latency and SSO timelines; renewal ~11mo out (renewal risk if we don't hit latency targets).
Priya (CS): Thanks Sam — can you list current blockers and any active tickets? also who is the technical contact on their side?
Sam (Sales): Active contact: lena@orchid.io (CTO). Blockers: 1) SSO (Okta) needs SCIM but not provisioned yet, 2) VPC peering needs subnet approval from their infra, 3) observed median gen latency ~220ms for chat during peak (they expect <180ms). Usage: ~2k requests/day, embeddings batch jobs nightly (~500/day).
Sam (Sales): Trial config snapshot: ```
account: orchid-thera-ct
deployment: dedicated-2gpu
expected_burst: 4gpu
sso: okta (no SCIM)
vpn: vpc-peering-requested
```
Marta (Solutions Eng): Noted. We can run a latency smoke with a canary config and check kernel selection. Need service account + sample payloads. Recommend canary: dedicated-2gpu-quantized, sequence cap 1024.
Diego (Support): I'll create an infra ticket and track VPC/peering. Sam — can you open a support request with: customer cid, VPC CIDR, preferred region, and any peering ACL? I'll attach to SUP-4582.
Sam (Sales): Created ticket SUP-4582 and added initial notes + lena's contact. Link: https://redwood.internal/sup/SUP-4582 (internal). Also uploaded their sample prompt set to the ticket.
Priya (CS): OK assigning owners: Priya -> onboarding owner / primary CS contact; Diego -> infra peering & latency triage; Marta -> SSO + canary; Sam -> commercial follow-ups and timeline.
Priya (CS): Immediate next steps (short): 1) Diego to validate peering feasibility and expected route times. 2) Marta to run canary and share perf numbers. 3) Diego/Marta to confirm if quantized variant meets latency SLO. 4) Priya to schedule technical kickoff with customer this week.
Diego (Support): Started infra check — can you confirm their VPC CIDR? (Sam) Also which region do they want? us-east-1 or eu-west-1?
Sam (Sales): They prefer us-east-1 for latency. VPC CIDR sent in SUP-4582 (10.10.0.0/16).
Marta (Solutions Eng): I'll prep the smoke script. Example command I'll run against their canary endpoint: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_KEY" -d '{"input": "short chat prompt"}' https://canary-dedicated-us-east-1.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
Priya (CS): Scheduling — I have slots Thu 10-11am or Fri 2-3pm PT. @LenaOK? Sam can you confirm which works for Orchid?
Sam (Sales): Sent options to Lena; she prefers Thu 10am PT. I've tentatively blocked it and added all owners. Calendar invite will include tech checklist and pre-call ask: SCIM enablement timeline and peering approvers.
Diego (Support): I'll update SUP-4582 with peering checklist and expected time to peer. If we need an escalated network review, will flag to eng-infra.
Priya (CS): Risk notes for renewal: customer has a competitor evaluating lower-latency offering. If canary can't hit <180ms median under expected load, flag as renewal risk (priority: medium-high). Capture pre/post-canary metrics for the account dashboard.
Sam (Sales): Noted — I'll keep commercial standby for discounted committed capacity if latency needs addressing post-canary.
Priya (CS): Action owners summary (for tracking): - Priya: kickoff + onboarding runbook + customer comms - Diego: SUP-4582, VPC peering, latency triage - Marta: canary run, SSO/SCIM integration tests - Sam: sales follow-up, calendar, commercial contingencies
Marta (Solutions Eng): Will post canary summary in the ticket and paste perf numbers here. If quantized variant is good, we can propose it as default for trial to reduce unit cost.
deploy-bot: Deployment event: canary-dedicated-2gpu deployed at 1771234600 by marta — logs attached.
Diego (Support): Canary logs pulled, initial median p50=170ms p95=420ms under light synthetic load. Need to simulate peak traffic pattern to be sure.
Priya (CS): Good start. Diego/Marta please update SUP-4582 with peak sim results and add a short blurb for CS dashboard. I'll follow up with a pre-kickoff checklist to the customer.
Sam (Sales): Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll move the commercial thread to standby and be on the kickoff. :thumbsup:
